title: DOW-UAP-PR066, "USCG C-144 Tyndall UAP 1 TIC TAC IR hot 24 April 2024"
what_is_it: Infrared video captured by a U.S. Coast Guard sensor platform, released as part of the PURSUE UAP disclosure collection.
interpretation_warnings: The uploader-defined title calls the object a 'TIC TAC' but AARO uses the neutral term 'area of contrast' — the TIC TAC label is not an official assessment.
Chain of custody is explicitly described as unsubstantiated, meaning the provenance and authenticity of the video cannot be independently verified.
The video description text appears truncated ('enters the fi'), so the full description of the second area of contrast is unavailable.
The video title and metadata were defined by the uploader, not by AARO or the Coast Guard.
This is a single-source recording with no corroborating sensor data or witness testimony described.
